title: Best Slow Cookers UK
short: Digital and manual slow cookers compared by capacity, features and price, from budget to multi-cooker.
intro: A slow cooker turns cheap cuts of meat and store-cupboard ingredients into a proper meal for a few pence of electricity, with almost no hands-on effort. This guide compares slow cookers tested by Mumsnet's panel in real kitchens, from budget manual models to searing multi-cookers.

products.name: Lift and Serve Digital Slow Cooker
products.best_for: Most households wanting an easy, reliable everyday slow cooker
products.summary: Mumsnet's overall winner. It has a digital display with a countdown timer and an automatic keep-warm function, and the bowl and lid are dishwasher-safe.
cons: Hinged lid design lets condensation drip
products.search: Crockpot Lift and Serve Digital Slow Cooker

products.name: Good-to-Go Multicooker
products.best_for: Families who want one pot that sears, slow-cooks and more
products.summary: A versatile multicooker with eight settings and a searing function, so meat can be browned in the same pot before it slow-cooks. Mumsnet rates it excellent value.
pros: Can sear meat in the same pot
cons: Control panel icons take getting used to

products.name: 461020 Sear and Stew
products.best_for: Cooks who want to brown meat on the hob before slow-cooking
products.summary: A slow cooker with a hob-safe aluminium pot, so you can sear meat directly in it before switching to slow-cook mode, though it has no keep-warm setting.

products.name: 6.5L Slow Cooker
products.best_for: Buyers who want maximum capacity for the lowest price
products.summary: A large-capacity, low-cost slow cooker with a keep-warm setting, though it has no timer and the pot must be hand-washed.

products.name: Retro Slow Cooker
products.best_for: Smaller households who want a slow cooker that looks good on the counter
products.summary: A stylish, smaller-capacity slow cooker at a low price, though its keep-warm setting is really just a low setting and the pot is not hob-safe.
cons: "Keep warm" is just a low setting

products.name: 3.5L Slow Cooker
products.best_for: Smaller households who want a classic ceramic slow cooker
products.summary: Expert Reviews' pick for small portions. Its ceramic pot retains heat well and the auto setting keeps food at serving temperature, and unlike most budget models here it is dishwasher-safe.

products.name: Chalk Board Slow Cooker
products.badge: Best for a fun family touch
products.best_for: Households who like labelling what's cooking
products.summary: Expert Reviews highlights the writable chalkboard surface, with a hob-safe ceramic pot (gas or electric hobs only) and a dishwasher-safe glass lid.
pros: Glass lid and ceramic pot both dishwasher-safe
cons: Exterior gets hot, needs oven gloves
products.search: Russell Hobbs Chalk Board Slow Cooker

products.name: RK302E15 8-in-1 Multi Cooker
products.best_for: Buyers who want a slow cooker that replaces several other appliances
products.key_spec: 5L, digital, 8 modes including rice and steam
products.summary: Expert Reviews rates this excellent value for its versatility, with eight digital modes including slow cook, rice, steam and porridge, though its lightweight metal pot does not retain heat as well for serving.
cons: Lightweight metal pot doesn't retain heat well for serving

guide.q: What size slow cooker do I need?
guide.a: As a rough guide, 3-3.5L suits one or two people, 4.5-5L suits a small family, and 6.5L or more suits a larger household or anyone who wants to batch-cook and freeze portions.

guide.q: Is a slow cooker cheap to run?
guide.a: Slow cookers use relatively low wattage, typically 200-750W depending on the model, over several hours, which usually costs a few pence to a low number of pounds per use depending on your electricity tariff and cooking time.

guide.q: Do I need a searing function?
guide.a: Browning meat before it goes into the slow cooker improves flavour. Some models, like the Morphy Richards and Russell Hobbs here, let you sear directly in the pot, saving you from dirtying a separate frying pan.

guide.q: Is it safe to leave a slow cooker on while out or overnight?
guide.a: Slow cookers are designed for long, low-temperature unattended cooking, which is their main purpose, but always follow the manufacturer's instructions, place it on a heatproof surface away from anything flammable, and make sure the plug and cable are in good condition.
